thread:
sam: Noticed eu-central1 gpu pool alerts: NVMe sustained write_iops ~92k and avg write latency creeping. Several gpu attach attempts timed out.
karim: I pulled ipc traces. The snapshot-reconciler is churning small 4K writes while it merges fragmented metadata shards. Happens after leader rebalances.
maria: Is this the same reconciler we tuned last quarter? We set it to aggressive to fix stale manifests quickly.
sam: Yeah, recent leader churn + reconciler aggressiveness = write amplification. We also have janitor compaction scheduled later, so concurrent background writes might be colliding.
ops-bot: :warning: eu-central1 NVMe write saturation detected. Metric: nvme_write_iops=92000 for 10m. Attached jobs failing: 6. Incident logged INF-4301.
karim: Quick mitigation options: (A) pause snapshot-reconciler workers (B) apply io-budget per-worker with token-bucket (C) temporarily scale ephemeral nvme-backed pool. Thoughts?
talia: Prefer (B) + (C). Pausing completely risks metadata inconsistency if we stall too long. Token-bucket with burst=200MB, refill=50MB/s should smooth loads.
maria: Scaling ephemeral pool will cost us reserved hours if we bump Dedicated nodes. How long do we expect mitigation to run?
sam: If we apply token-bucket, should see relief in ~2-5 mins. Plan: set RECONCILER_IO_BURST=200MB and RECONCILER_IO_RATE=50MB_S, and add a soft cap on concurrent shards. Karim, can you roll that without a full restart?
karim: I can patch the reconciler configmap and do a rolling restart of the reconciler Deployment. Command: `kubectl patch deployment snapshot-reconciler -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"reconciler.patched":"true"}}}}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/snapshot-reconciler`. Doing now.
ops-bot: :information_source: Patch applied. Rolling restart started.
sam: Monitoring IOPS. Maria, if IOPS doesn't drop in 7 mins, please spin up 2 ephemeral nvme instances in eu-central and attach to pool (scale target +20%). We'll revert after stable.
maria: Spawning 2 nodes now in the spare queue, will tag as ephemeral-scale-4301. Noted cost vs. SLO tradeoff.
karim: Telemetry: within 90s post-rollout, small-write rate dropped ~58%, overall write_iops down to ~38k. Attach latency improving.
talia: Filing a follow-up action: reduce reconciler concurrency during leader elections, and add a leader-stability guard (delay heavy merges until 3min stable). Will write RFC R-258.
sam: Nice. Also add a knob for emergency I/O backoff in control plane so oncall can throttle without deploys.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INF-4301 marked 'mitigated' pending 1h observation.
maria: Leaving the ephemeral-scale nodes up for 1 hour to smooth any residual churn, then we'll deprovision. Cost estimate ~0.9u for the hour.
sam: Great work. Follow-up owners: karim (deploy backoff knob), talia (RFC R-258), maria (deprovision schedule). Will close if no regressions.
